items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we had a crazy bus driver, Bob Bates... Kooky guy.

ctx.x: So, we’re going to being her on the bus. So she came on the bus and sat with him and it was all love and kisses and marvelous, I said, “Yeah” I said, “Great, that’s great, they’re going to get married, that’s nice.” And time went on and I kind of heard this arguing and carrying on. And finally, I hear her say, “where’s my hat, I want my hat.” “Here’s your hat, you bitch,” or whatever, bla bla bla. And they storm through the isle and it was the middle of the night, it must have been three or four in the morning.…
